description: Hills Creek Dam is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Hoopes, Ashton (deposited on HydroShare). This is real time data provided by the Army Corps of Engineers Northwestern Division the Hills Creek Dam on the Williamette River Fork, four miles southwest of OakRidge, Oregon. This is data that will constantly update so the screen grads that will be attached are for January and February of 2021 only. Coverage: Oregon, United States. The resource was created 2021-02-26 and last updated 2021-03-05; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
